summary: Macerich Co. filed a Form 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market (ATM) equity offering of up to $500 million of common stock, with $211.5 million already sold and $288.5 million remaining. Sales are through agents including J.P. Morgan, Deutsche Bank, BMO, Goldman Sachs, and others under an equity distribution agreement. Commissions up to 2% of gross proceeds will be paid. This is a routine capital raise under an existing shelf registration, not a special situation, with no deal terms or strategic event involved.
